biotools.summary: Bell Jar is a semiautomated tool for aligning and annotating mouse brain tissue sections with a reference atlas, facilitating high-throughput neuroanatomy studies. It utilizes B-spline transformations and allows for cellular resolution analysis, improving the efficiency and reproducibility of histological analyses.
